scope: Centreline lengths under imposed TPU deformation. Positive take-up means cable path shortens. Three-point radii use stored stations and are local curvature indicators. Capstan sensitivity assumes sliding contact over every sampled turn and is applied after equilibrium. It does not predict static friction, contact distribution, return hysteresis or a new motion.
